faq_plan.q: What is a meal train sign up sheet?
How do I create a meal train sign up sheet?

plan.angle: The top 10 for meal train sign up sheet is printable grids on Etsy and Pinterest, a Facebook group post and form templates: a list of dates with a blank for a name. This page shows the sheet as a working schedule for the four situations that start meal trains: a new-baby train with a porch cooler and a quiet drop-off window, a surgery recovery that runs three nights a week, a church care team covering a family after a death, and a household that needs every cook to read an allergy note first. The how-to and FAQ add what printables skip: how long to run it, keeping the address private, avoiding three lasagnas, reminders, and gift-card days.
tab_stories: Twins came home to the Gildersleeve house, and their 14-night meal train asks cooks to leave dinner in the porch cooler between 5 and 6 pm, with the address and a reminder emailed the day before.
After knee surgery, Jorunn Mirabeau gets dinner every Monday, Wednesday and Friday for 4 weeks, and each cook sees what is already coming that week before picking a dish.
Brierfield Chapel's care team covers 10 days of meals for a family after a funeral, and any date still open 2 days out sends an email to care-team lead Augustina Hartsfeld.
The Lowenhart household keeps peanuts and tree nuts out of the house, so each cook ticks a box saying they read the allergy note and lists the dish's main ingredients.
